title: Interpreting human genetic variation at atomic resolution.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: There are no data files to open. Crossref records a journal-article with 195 references and no supplementary material; Europe PMC types it as 'Review', isOpenAccess=N, inPMC=N, hasSuppl=N, hasData=N, hasDbCrossReferences=N, hasTMAccessionNumbers=N. paper_context.py returned zero accessions, zero NCBI links (GEO, SRA, BioProject, BioSample, dbGaP) and zero repository hits. A Zenodo search on the exact title returned 0 records. The nature.com page redirects to a login wall (HTTP 303 to idp.nature.com), so no full text or data-availability statement is retrievable.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the content comes from the 160-word abstract alone, which states 'In this Perspective...' and describes a conceptual framework (computational structural genomics) rather than any new measurement. Authors are Michael T. Zimmermann and Raul Urrutia (Medical College of Wisconsin); received 13 Nov 2025, accepted 19 Aug 2026.

a1_downloadable.note: FAIL. This is a Perspective (opinion/review) article, not a data paper. No dataset, no supplementary files, no accession numbers, no repository deposit, and no Zenodo/Dryad record exist. The article itself is paywalled. There is literally nothing to download.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: FAIL by consequence of A1. No table exists, so no prediction target exists as a column. Any label would have to be assembled entirely from third-party resources the Perspective merely cites.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not assessed beyond A1: no files, so no input features of any kind are provided.

a4_units_stated.note: Not assessed beyond A1: no measurements, therefore no units.

a5_enough_rows.note: Zero rows. The paper contributes narrative text and 195 citations.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Trivially true and meaningless — there is no data to load.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No counts to compare; the abstract reports no sample sizes because the paper reports no experiment.

a8_label_provenance.note: Not applicable. Worth noting that the paper's whole subject is the output of existing predictors (AlphaFold models, molecular dynamics simulations, AI variant-effect tools), so any label built from its cited content would be another model's prediction — exactly the circularity A8 is written to catch.

honest_claim_h3: No claim is possible: the paper publishes no data, so no model can be trained or evaluated from it.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use three-dimensional protein structure features to predict whether a human genetic variant disrupts the protein's function.
plain_idea.train_on: The project considered would use, for each amino-acid-changing variant, structural context from a predicted or experimental structure plus the protein sequence. Number of examples from this paper: zero — it supplies no variant table.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a variant is damaging and by what mechanism (folding, binding, catalysis). True answers would have to come from clinical classifications (ClinVar) or laboratory deep mutational scanning, neither of which this paper provides.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Clinical geneticists need mechanism, not just a damaging/benign score, to pick a treatment or a follow-up assay. But this Perspective adds no data toward that, so the idea would have to be built entirely from other people's resources.

ml_idea: None available from this paper. A structure-aware variant-effect project would have to be sourced entirely from the resources this Perspective reviews (AlphaFold DB, ClinVar, MaveDB/ProteinGym) and would then compete directly with AlphaMissense, ESM-1v, EVE and PrimateAI-3D — a crowded field entered with no data advantage.

effort.compute_note: No compute estimate is meaningful because there is no dataset. Nothing was timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check the article type and the supplementary-file list. Europe PMC types it 'Review' with hasSuppl=N and hasData=N — that alone kills it in under a minute.

verdict_reason: Perspective/review article with no primary data: no files, accessions or repository deposit anywhere. Part A1 fails immediately.
